title: Connection of Multi-Valued Topological Groups with Neutrosophic Multi-Valued Functions
content: The purpose of this paper is to establish a systematic connection between multi-valued topological groups and neutrosophic multi-valued functions. Multi-valued algebraic structures generalize ordinary algebraic operations by allowing the product of two elements to be a nonempty subset rather than a single element. Hypergroups in the sense of Marty constitute one of the principal frameworks for such structures. On the other hand, neutrosophic theory incorporates truth, indeterminacy, and falsity components, while multi-valued neutrosophic sets permit these components to take sets of values rather than single numbers. We introduce a class of neutrosophic multi-valued functions adapted to compact-valued mappings and construct the neutrosophic lift of a multi-valued topological group. We define neutrosophic translations, neutrosophic hyperoperations, neutrosophic inverse maps, neutrosophic subgroups, and neutrosophic continuous homomorphisms. Several structural results are proved. In particular, we show that a Vietoris-continuous multi-valued group operation induces a natural neutrosophic multi-valued group-valued function whenever its three neutrosophic components are Vietoris-continuous. Conversely, suitable level-set conditions allow one to recover the underlying multi-valued topology from the neutrosophic representation. A principal result establishes an equivalence, under natural regularity conditions, between continuity of a neutrosophic multi-valued operation and simultaneous continuity of its truth, indeterminacy, and falsity components. We also investigate neutrosophic α-cuts, level hypergroups, neutrosophic subgroups, homomorphisms, quotient structures, and convergence. The resulting theory provides a bridge between topological hyperstructure theory, set-valued analysis, and neutrosophic mathematics.
